capabilities: Edit or overwrite note properties based on canvas node and group connections
Create labeled (typed) links between notes through canvas edges
Generate a canvas from a note's list-type properties
Mass-edit properties on multiple notes at once from one canvas
Pull existing note properties into a canvas as nodes and arrows
extras: Only list-type properties can be edited; Text, Number, Checkbox, Date, and Date & Time properties are unsupported. Individual node-type behaviors can be toggled off and certain property keys can be ignored.
intentEvidence: gives canvases the power to edit file properties visually
problem: Canvases in Obsidian are only visual: connections drawn on them cannot write properties back to the notes they contain, and editing properties across many notes is manual.

relations.evidence: Thank you to Ben Hughes, whose work on the awesome Link Exploder was enormously helpful.

summary: Canvas-based editor that sets note properties from canvas connections and generates canvases from a note's list-type properties.
